# Domi Jin — Background, interests and reading notes

> Scientist. Builder. Founder.
> A sci-fi mind. An engineer’s hands.

- **Website**: https://domij.info/
- **04 · Civic Scale — Civilization: It Takes All Kinds**: https://domij.info/#working-together — shared values, distinct perspectives and learning together; includes the shared-knowledge interactive essay.
- **Euclidean wormhole learning page (English)**: `https://domij.info/wormholes/`. An interactive note adapted from the supplied summary of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MmfEEqiUrfo (captions unavailable). Includes a real-time GPU 4th-order Runge–Kutta null-geodesic ray-tracer and paired 2D ray cross-section covering the smooth Lorentzian DNEG throat (James et al. 2015, arXiv:1502.03809), a schematic WKB Euclidean pinch-off bounce, static BTZ null rays inside a reflective AdS₃ boundary box, and an illustrative ensemble/de Sitter contrast, alongside schematic topology, leading Cardy–BTZ entropy, and an exact three-member two-level ensemble. Euclidean saddles do not support Lorentzian travel. Primary references: arXiv:2002.08950, hep-th/9712251, 1405.5137, 1903.11115, 1912.00222, 2203.06511 and 1502.03809. General ensemble measures and de Sitter extension remain open questions.
- **Atmospheric Newtonian noise learning page (English)**: `https://domij.info/newtonian-noise/`. Interactive study adapted from Wenhui Wang's 2025 UT Arlington Ph.D. dissertation record (mavmatrix.uta.edu/physics_dissertations/180; automated PDF download blocked with HTTP 403) and Wenhui Wang & Teviet Creighton (2025, arXiv:2505.05690). Features a split Three.js 3D physical scene and synchronized abstracted geometric model & camera frustum, generalized finite-Q infrasound shielding, cycloidal Kolmogorov advection vs smooth laminar wind, an in-browser 1D radix-2 FFT Monte Carlo matching Eq. (A.2), digitized detector budgets (aLIGO, ET, CE, TOBA, SOGRO), surface shelter effective depth D_eff, and the Section 5 volumetric tomography estimate (~10^5–10^6 sensors at 1 Hz over 100 m). Primary references: mavmatrix.uta.edu/physics_dissertations/180, arXiv:2505.05690, gr-qc/0007050, Fiorucci et al. (2018), Brundu et al. (2022), Harms (2019).

## Three ways into the work

In 2023 I was trying to work out which problems I could keep working on while earning a living and looking after my family. I still want to build a business that can pay its own way. When a decision helps the business survive, I also want to know who had a say and who bears the cost.

- **Back an idea.** Start with the need that led me to build for older adults. Then see what older drivers asked for in practice. [Starting a New Venture](https://domij.info/articles/substack/starting-a-new-venture.html) and [Tesla, Seniors Love Your Self-Driving—Now Let’s Make It Safer for Them](https://domij.info/articles/substack/tesla-seniors-love-your-self-drivingnow.html).
- **Build together.** Read the household agent specification alongside a field account of how older adults experience voice controls and alerts. [baby-AI: Raising a Household Agent on Edge Hardware](https://domij.info/articles/github/baby-ai.html) and [Tesla, Seniors Love Your Self-Driving—Now Let’s Make It Safer for Them](https://domij.info/articles/substack/tesla-seniors-love-your-self-drivingnow.html).
- **Learn and teach.** Pair my working draft on education with a proposed experiment on what a learner can still do after closing the chat. [Open Learning: From Individual Potential to Collective Discovery](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.html) and [Open Learning Lab: Beyond the Fluency Illusion with an 8-Agent Closed-Loop Pipeline](https://domij.info/articles/github/open-learning-lab.html).

## Background

I work on machine learning and decision systems. My background is in computational astrophysics; my current interests are learning, human judgement and how people work together.

### Computational astrophysics
Ph.D. Physics (2013–2018) · LSST Data Science Fellow

I began in computational astrophysics, studying stellar dynamics and binary black holes through numerical simulation and statistical modelling.

- Numerical simulations of globular clusters using N-body and Monte Carlo methods (3,240 MOCCA simulations across 662,772 globular clusters in 8,946 galaxies within D ≤ 30 Mpc).
- Analysis of binary black hole evolution (17,883,760 inspiralling BBHs and 86,939 mergers) and gravitational-wave detection prospects for LISA, deriving a lower-bound local merger rate of η ≃ 587 Gpc⁻³ yr⁻¹ and identifying 17 extragalactic standard sirens localized to ΔV ≤ 1 Mpc³.
- LSST Data Science Fellowship: statistical modelling, image processing and reproducible research workflows.

### Decision systems
Applied ML & Decision Intelligence (2018–2024)

I then worked on machine learning for consumer products, marketplaces and advertising, where a model has to be useful within the constraints of a working system.

- Recommendation systems using behavioural and contextual signals from mobility data.
- Marketplace pricing, generative AI request workflows and information exchange between users.
- Advertising analytics, model evaluation and causal attribution; published architecture notes on real-time bidding and multi-agent control.

### Learning and human–AI collaboration
Independent projects & ventures (2018–present)

Building a company brought me closer to the people using the technology. It made me more attentive to what they need, and to the gap between a promising idea and something useful.

- Kin Domi, Inc.: AI and community projects concerned with older adults’ independence and access to technology.
- Open Learning Lab and baby-AI: open research into learning, and specifications for a household agent that runs on local hardware.
- Essays on learning, team coordination and human–AI collaboration in Domi’s Mind Waves and elsewhere.

## Approach

### Working together

Good work depends on more than individual ability. Shared context, trust, complementary skills and sensible incentives matter, as does room for people to exercise their own judgement.

### Usefulness

I judge technology by what it helps people do: understand a problem, make a choice, learn a skill or spend their time better. Technical elegance is valuable when it serves that purpose.

### Testing the idea

I try to make assumptions explicit, build something that can be tested and pay attention to the result. Revising an explanation is part of the work.

These are ongoing questions. The linked work distinguishes observations, proposals and research findings. Project specifications describe intended behaviour; they should not be treated as evidence that every target has been met. Reading notes summarise the linked work, including proposals and personal reflections.

## Questions and related writing

All articles published on external platforms (Substack, Medium, GitHub) are mirrored locally under `https://domij.info/articles/` in both HTML and Markdown formats, with explicit references to the original source.

### Collective Intelligence

How do individual capabilities combine to produce collective outcomes?

I am interested in how shared knowledge, communication and trust help groups make use of what their members know.

- [Serendipity: where it sparks](https://domij.info/articles/substack/serendipity-where-it-sparks.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/substack/serendipity-where-it-sparks.md) · [Substack](https://domijin.substack.com/p/serendipity-where-it-sparks)) (Substack, 2024-12): A personal reflection on connections between astrophysics, Confucian ethics and work across disciplines.
  Reading note: The essay considers how ideas from physics, machine learning and human–computer interaction can inform one another.
- [Free Market in a Possibility Universe & The Collaborative Manifesto](https://domij.info/articles/blog/free-market-in-a-possibility-universe.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/blog/free-market-in-a-possibility-universe.md) · [Original page](https://domij.info/free-market-in-a-possibility-universe.html)) (Blog, 2019-09): Explores information asymmetry, resource coordination and proposals for liquid democracy.
  Reading note: The proposal considers how individual ownership and collective decision-making might be reconciled.

### Human–AI Collaboration

How can intelligent systems support human judgement and agency?

Current projects explore personal memory, voice and messaging interfaces, and local processing, with attention to privacy and human judgement.

- [baby-AI: Raising a Household Agent on Edge Hardware](https://domij.info/articles/github/baby-ai.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/github/baby-ai.md) · [GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/baby-AI)) (GitHub, 2026-04; design specification, not a shipped product): Eight subsystem specifications covering system charter, perception, speech recognition, memory, interaction, evaluation, privacy and escalation, targeting local hardware around $100–$150 BOM.
  Reading note: The specification uses signed evaluation records to make claims about on-device learning and privacy inspectable.
- [Life Hack: iMessage as a Low-Bandwidth Router to the Internet](https://domij.info/articles/blog/imessage-ai-router.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/blog/imessage-ai-router.md) · [Beta page](https://domij.info/beta/)) (Blog, 2026-04): An experiment in using messaging to reach internet-connected agents over limited connections, including in-flight Wi-Fi and satellite text.
  Reading note: Messaging offers a familiar, asynchronous interface for asking an agent to do something without keeping a browser session open.
- [Another team building Skynet, in the name of Jarvis — AMA](https://domij.info/articles/medium/another-team-building-skynet-in-the-name-of-jarvis-ama-163389dc5285.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/medium/another-team-building-skynet-in-the-name-of-jarvis-ama-163389dc5285.md) · [Medium](https://medium.com/@domijin/another-team-building-skynet-in-the-name-of-jarvis-ama-163389dc5285)) (Medium, 2024-11): An architectural discussion of personal AI memory, local voice processing, privacy in query rewriting and browser context.
  Reading note: The discussion explores how local processing and selective use of cloud services might balance personal context, privacy and cost.
- [Why is some professional handwriting illegible?](https://domij.info/articles/medium/why-is-some-professional-handwriting-illegible-d07bd8acb818.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/medium/why-is-some-professional-handwriting-illegible-d07bd8acb818.md) · [Medium](https://medium.com/@domijin/why-is-some-professional-handwriting-illegible-d07bd8acb818)) (Medium, 2023-10): An exploration of documentation bottlenecks, the bandwidth of speech and writing, and institutional information barriers.
  Reading note: The essay asks whether voice interfaces could reduce the effort of recording information at its source.

### Organisational Intelligence

How do communication, coordination, trust, and incentives shape collaboration?

My writing considers shared values, complementary skills, incentives and the practical costs of coordination.

- [Overachiever’s Responsibility: Reflection on Leadership, Alignment, and Sustainable Growth](https://domij.info/articles/substack/overachievers-responsibility-reflection.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/substack/overachievers-responsibility-reflection.md) · [Substack](https://domijin.substack.com/p/overachievers-responsibility-reflection)) (Substack, 2025-02): A reflection on team alignment, complementary skills and sustainable working habits.
  Reading note: The essay uses greatest common divisors and least common multiples as metaphors for shared values and complementary skills, and considers incentives before expectations.
- [A Colorful Year Ahead](https://domij.info/articles/substack/a-colorful-year-ahead.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/substack/a-colorful-year-ahead.md) · [Substack](https://domijin.substack.com/p/a-colorful-year-ahead)) (Substack, 2025-01): Notes on the eighth revision of a working model built around shared calendars, asynchronous collaboration and weekly reflection.
  Reading note: The working model explores whether shared calendars and asynchronous contributions can make coordination easier.

### Complex Adaptive Systems

How do interactions among individuals give rise to emergent social and organisational behaviour?

Stellar dynamics, traffic and marketplaces raise related questions about interactions and feedback. I use these comparisons as starting points, with care about where the analogy stops.

The clearest case is my doctoral work, and it is where this site starts: a globular cluster of a million stars is a complex adaptive system read from the outside in. Slow, cumulative encounters among the stars reorganise the cluster itself, sink the heaviest remnants into its core, and pair them into binaries that are then thrown out into the halo. Nothing about the outcome is designed; it is what a million-body system does when its members keep interacting. That is the same grammar I keep meeting in traffic, in marketplaces and in teams, which is why the arc of this site runs from a million stars to the person sitting next to you.

- [Trace of AppLovin’s 7x Annual Hypergrowth](https://domij.info/articles/medium/trace-of-applovins-7x-annual-hypergrowth-39dcb154f5d0.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/medium/trace-of-applovins-7x-annual-hypergrowth-39dcb154f5d0.md) · [Medium](https://medium.com/@domijin/trace-of-applovins-7x-annual-hypergrowth-39dcb154f5d0)) (Medium, 2024-11): An analysis of behavioural data, scaling and latency constraints in advertising, with questions about the costs of continued growth.
  Reading note: The analysis asks where additional behavioural data stops adding useful value, and who bears the costs of the resulting systems.
- [From Traffic Lights to Life’s Direction](https://domij.info/articles/medium/from-traffic-lights-to-lifes-direction-57176d5d7a06.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/medium/from-traffic-lights-to-lifes-direction-57176d5d7a06.md) · [Medium](https://domijin.medium.com/from-traffic-lights-to-lifes-direction-57176d5d7a06)) (Medium, 2023-10): Explores how traffic-light timing might be inferred from crowdsourced trajectories, alongside reflections from Wolfram Summer School and the 2023 question on which work to sustain.
  Reading note: The piece considers what can be inferred from movement data, and where symbolic computation might complement language models.
- [Prospective Detection of Binary Black Holes in the Local Universe with Gravitational Waves](https://domij.info/articles/research/astrophysics-bbh-dissertation.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/research/astrophysics-bbh-dissertation.md) · [PDF](https://domij.info/pdfs/main.pdf) · [Research page](https://domij.info/pages/research.html)) (Research, 2018-07): Doctoral work on globular clusters and binary black holes, alongside notes on reproducible computational research.
  Reading note: Numerical simulation, statistical analysis and reproducible workflows provided the methodological basis for my later work.

### Decision Intelligence

How can information, feedback, and experimentation improve decisions?

Work on causal inference, experimentation and decision systems has made me interested in what we measure, and whether it reflects the outcome we care about.

- [Trace of AppLovin’s 7x Annual Hypergrowth](https://domij.info/articles/github/observations-in-advertising.html) (repository edition; [Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/github/observations-in-advertising.md) · [GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/observations_in_advertising)) (GitHub, 2024-11): The living repository edition of the AppLovin essay: the four growth drivers, the four areas where the paradigm is shifting, the growth trap, and the author’s own account of where the work came from.
  Reading note: Growth that depends on scaling data collection carries an economic, ethical and social cost that the scaling law alone does not price in.
- [Is Dark Mode Doing More Harm Than Good? A Deeper Look at Our Choices](https://domij.info/articles/medium/is-dark-mode-doing-more-harm-than-good-a-deeper-look-at-our-choices-a9685daad170.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/medium/is-dark-mode-doing-more-harm-than-good-a-deeper-look-at-our-choices-a9685daad170.md) · [Medium](https://medium.com/@domijin/is-dark-mode-doing-more-harm-than-good-a-deeper-look-at-our-choices-a9685daad170)) (Medium, 2024-11): Uses the visual ergonomics of dark mode as a case study to critique short-term agile feature shipping versus long-term user welfare.
  Reading note: The essay asks how product teams can account for longer-term effects alongside the immediate feedback from feature releases.
- [Rethinking Digital Advertising: From Guesswork to User Engagement](https://domij.info/articles/medium/rethinking-digital-advertising-from-guesswork-to-user-engagement-6e1916a2aced.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/medium/rethinking-digital-advertising-from-guesswork-to-user-engagement-6e1916a2aced.md) · [Medium](https://domijin.medium.com/rethinking-digital-advertising-from-guesswork-to-user-engagement-6e1916a2aced)) (Medium, 2024-10): Proposes richer intent models, compact user profiles and interfaces that let users request different advertisements.
  Reading note: Letting users request different advertisements is proposed as a way to collect more deliberate preference feedback.

### Human Potential

- **[Open Learning: From Individual Potential to Collective Discovery](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.html)** ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.md)) · Working draft, 17 November 2026. Four proposed courses—effective altruism, future thinking, design thinking and positive psychology—are intended to develop purpose, potentials, communication and resilience. Three independent experience principles (informative, interactive, adaptive) apply across all four courses. Proposes individual mastery and independent or voluntary collective inquiry, with evidence, critique and revision before claims enter the commons. Not a programme evaluation or implementation claim. Includes the decoded [Learning about Learning mind map](https://domij.info/articles/blog/learning-about-learning.html) as source context.
- **[Two people, a wider horizon](https://domij.info/shared-knowledge/)**: An interactive essay connecting education and knowledge sharing to a collaborative society. Two fictional collaborators compare schematic competence maps, disclose context, check an interpretation, align on a question, examine synthetic evidence and prepare a local provisional note. Common topics are not checked understanding; neither agreement nor a quiz certifies mastery or truth. Negative results can contribute. No real profiles, model downloads or publication. [Open Learning draft](https://domij.info/articles/blog/open-learning.html).
- **[我对未来教育的期待 (Future of Education, Chinese brief)](https://domij.info/future-of-education/)**: A concise Chinese overview (`zh-CN`) of Domi Jin's working expectations for the future of education, synthesising Open Learning, Open Learning Lab, Two people, a wider horizon, and LibertyEarth into a brief Chinese-language page. Working hypothesis, not an implemented programme or measured result.

How can technology make learning, opportunity, and meaningful participation more accessible?

Open Learning Lab asks whether learning with AI leads to understanding that lasts and can be used independently. Other writing considers play and learning throughout life.

- [Open Learning Lab: Beyond the Fluency Illusion with an 8-Agent Closed-Loop Pipeline](https://domij.info/articles/github/open-learning-lab.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/github/open-learning-lab.md) · [GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/open-learning-lab)) (GitHub, 2026-08; proposed experiment protocol, not a completed trial): An open research ledger proposing to test which LLM-mediated learning policies produce durable, transferable capability per unit of learner effort outside the tutoring session.
  Reading note: The protocol asks whether making a design judgement before seeing an expert solution improves later recall and transfer compared with explanation-first tutoring.
- [🌱 Reclaiming Play as a Life Skill](https://domij.info/articles/substack/reclaiming-play-as-a-life-skill.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/substack/reclaiming-play-as-a-life-skill.md) · [Substack](https://domijin.substack.com/p/reclaiming-play-as-a-life-skill)) (Substack, 2025-03): Examines Jane McGonigal's game mechanics (goals, rules, feedback systems, voluntary participation) through conversations with senior learners and retirees.
  Reading note: The essay considers what clear goals, feedback and voluntary participation can contribute to learning throughout life.
- [Starting a New Venture](https://domij.info/articles/substack/starting-a-new-venture.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/substack/starting-a-new-venture.md) · [Substack](https://domijin.substack.com/p/starting-a-new-venture)) (Substack, 2024-12): Early founder’s log on customer research, community outreach and forming the team behind Kin Domi, Inc.
  Reading note: Conversations about difficulties with technology often led to broader questions about independence, dignity and purpose.
- [Reflections from Coach-Seeking Impulse](https://domij.info/articles/substack/reflections-from-coach-seeking-impulse.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/substack/reflections-from-coach-seeking-impulse.md) · [Substack](https://domijin.substack.com/p/reflections-from-coach-seeking-impulse)) (Substack, 2024-12): Examines the mechanics of coaching, intellectual honesty, and why shared context determines the effectiveness of feedback.
  Reading note: The reflection considers how honesty and shared context affect the usefulness of coaching.

### AI and Society

How might increasingly capable intelligence change the ways we work, cooperate, and live?

Essays consider accessibility, autonomy and the incentives behind AI systems, including observations from work with older adults.

- [Tesla, Seniors Love Your Self-Driving—Now Let’s Make It Safer for Them](https://domij.info/articles/substack/tesla-seniors-love-your-self-drivingnow.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/substack/tesla-seniors-love-your-self-drivingnow.md) · [Substack](https://domijin.substack.com/p/tesla-seniors-love-your-self-drivingnow)) (Substack, 2025-03): Observations from work with older adults at Kin Domi, alongside six proposals for more accessible driving-assistance interfaces (proposals, not implemented vehicle changes).
  Reading note: The article proposes changes to alert timing, pre-drive checks and voice controls, based on difficulties observed with older users.
- [All About ChatGPT: Flat Correlation, Unit Economics & Alignment](https://domij.info/articles/blog/all-about-chatgpt.html) ([Markdown](https://domij.info/articles/blog/all-about-chatgpt.md) · [Original page](https://domij.info/all-about-chatgpt.html)) (Blog, 2023-02): A 2023 essay on language models, search economics, symbolic computation and the limitations of feedback used for alignment.
  Reading note: The essay asks how statistical prediction relates to reasoning, and who should participate in decisions about model behaviour.
- [Knowledge boundary — an interactive sketch](https://domij.info/knowledge/): The same argument as the 2023 essay, drawn as geometry. Collective human knowledge is a spiky ball — deep in some fields, thin in others — and a language model grows as a smoother, lagging copy inside it, fed by the results experts produce at the frontier. The model ends up close to the frontier in mathematics and passes outside the human graph in the thinnest fields. A small sentence-embedding model runs in the reader's browser and lights up the concepts a prompt reaches for; a WebLLM decoder can propose concepts that are not yet in the diagram.

## Projects

- **[Open Learning Lab](https://domij.info/articles/github/open-learning-lab.html)** ([GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/open-learning-lab)): An open research ledger and proposed experiment protocol comparing approaches to learning with language models, focusing on delayed recall and independent transfer rather than completed trial outcomes.
- **[baby-AI](https://domij.info/articles/github/baby-ai.html)** ([GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/baby-AI)): Eight subsystem specifications covering system charter, perception, speech recognition, memory, interaction, evaluation, privacy and escalation. The specification targets local hardware (~$100–$150 BOM) with signed evaluation records; it is a design specification, not a shipped hardware product.
- **[Life Hack: iMessage as a Low-Bandwidth Router to the Internet](https://domij.info/articles/blog/imessage-ai-router.html)** ([Beta page](https://domij.info/beta/)): An experiment in using iMessage to reach internet-connected agents when normal browsing is limited. It explores how a familiar, asynchronous interface can work with constrained connections.
- **[Kin Domi, Inc.](https://kindomi.net/)** ([Founder’s log](https://domij.info/articles/substack/starting-a-new-venture.html)): Venture incorporated in December 2024 around accessible interfaces, AI tools and community activities in Palo Alto, informed by older adults’ experiences of technology, mobility and learning.
- **[Advertising decision systems](https://domij.info/articles/github/observations-in-advertising.html)** ([GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/observations_in_advertising)): Notes on ad-serving architecture, real-time bidding constraints, advertising economics and the growth trap.
- **[LibertyEarth & The Future Project](https://domij.info/articles/github/libertyearth-and-future.html)** ([GitHub](https://github.com/domijin/LibertyEarth)): An evolving collection of proposals about social contracts, liquid democracy, local manufacturing and ways of turning ideas into practical experiments.
